subject: Arcology Lurker
promptProvenance: Source prompt hashes identify the production contract; actual ImageGen prompts are separately preserved in the production state.

scaleCalibrationReview.note: Manual rigid cranial-dome chords calibrate move, attack and death to idle. The attack short-spill path reconstructs every foreground pixel exactly; no geometry retouch was used because it would downscale and then re-upscale fine hooked digits.

physicalAnchorReview.method: Manual whole-board review on a 25 px nominal-cell grid. The anatomical landmark is the visually stable ventral ribcage center and is unchanged by this correction. The physical root shares its x coordinate and projects vertically to the observed load-bearing paw/digit support line, then adds the complete four-pixel extraction margin so anchorY equals sourceBounds[3] in every pose. Tail-tip extrema are excluded. Death uses the corpse contact plane. Attack frame 2 uses the authored action plane at the lowest distal limb because the torso is airborne. This is standalone physical-registration evidence, not runtime acceptance.
